DocsPage.metaDescription: How to maintain this wiki with external tools (MCP, Skill, REST) instead of the app's built-in AI
DocsPage.title: Integration Guide
DocsPage.intro: How to maintain this wiki with external tools without the app's built-in AI — the MCP and Skill of external agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), plus the REST API. Whichever path you use, they all follow the same content API and classification rules, so your wiki stays consistent.
DocsPage.introSlugFilled: The {slug} in the examples below is already filled in with this wiki's slug.
DocsPage.introSlugPlaceholder: Replace {slug} in the examples with the target wiki's slug.
DocsPage.section3Title: 3. Method B — Maintainer skill (Claude Code, Codex, etc.)
DocsPage.sectionAuthTitle: Auth boundary — what works with an API key and what doesn't

section1.auth: Every external call authenticates via the {header} header. The raw key is shown only once at issuance, so store it safely.
section1.li1: Issue one on the <link>API keys</link> screen (editor or higher for write operations).
section1.li2: You can scope a key to a specific wiki or set a max role (maxRole) and expiry. Effective role = min(membership role, maxRole).
section1.li3: Up to 20 active keys per account. Rate limit: 120/min and 3000/hour (if exceeded, 429 + Retry-After).

section2.intro: Register the repo's mcp/server.mjs to expose a wiki-kind-aware profile and content tools.
section2.hermesLabel: Hermes — key in ~/.hermes/.env, environment placeholder in YAML

section3.p1: The repo's skills/wiki-ingest/ skill bundle is a workflow for external maintainers — covering not just ingesting sources but also classifying, organizing, automated linting, and querying. It isn't tied to any specific agent, so it runs as tools where MCP is supported and via REST otherwise, following the same procedure. It copies the same classification rules (ontology/categories) from the canonical source as the internal ingest agent and enforces byte-parity in CI, so classification stays consistent whether you add content via the web UI or the skill.
section3.p2: Ingest procedure: 1. store the source immutably with create_source, 2. check for duplicates with search/list_pages, 3. write a source note with kind=note (summarize, don't paste the raw text), 4. update affected concepts/entities ([[slug]] links, reuse categories), 5. add embed:true on the final call for semantic indexing.
section3.bundleLabel: Bundle contents (copy the whole folder into any harness):
section3.li2: references/ontology-rules.md — canonical copy of the classification rules (CI byte-parity check).
section3.li3: references/tools.md — capability ↔ MCP tool ↔ REST mapping + auth boundary.
section3.li4: references/setup.md — API key, MCP registration, per-harness placement (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).

section4.fullRef: The full reference (all endpoints, responses, and error codes) is in the repo at docs/rest-api.md.

auth.intro: "Auth boundary = cost boundary." Generative curation is quota-limited, and protected notes stay hidden beyond the external-model boundary.
auth.card1Body: Read/write pages and documents, preserve/curate ingest, store/read sources, search, reading-list promotion, and job polling
auth.card2Body: /query, /reindex, {lint}, and ingest file uploads are web-session only. JSON ingest accepts API keys

DocsPage.footer: Reference files — Skill bundle: skills/wiki-ingest/ (SKILL.md + references/) · MCP: mcp/server.mjs · REST: docs/rest-api.md
